title: I'VE TAKEN MY HARP DOWN

lines.text: I've taken my harp down from the willow tree,
My heart is singing the victory.
My past is forgiven, my home is in heaven.
All sorrow has gone the glory has come,

lyrics:
[Verse]
I've taken my harp down from the willow tree,
My heart is singing the victory.
My past is forgiven, my home is in heaven.
All sorrow has gone the glory has come,
And now I am free.
